tools.name: singer_sing
tools.description: Sing one line aloud on this computer in your singing voice. Use it whenever the person asks you to sing, hum, or casually "sing a few lines": actually sing instead of only answering in text. Call it first, wait for this result, then call pet_say with exactly the text this tool returns (the lyric line) so the bubble appears together with the voice. If the person asks to sing slower/faster, higher/lower or in a different mood, pass bpm / keyShift / scale in this same call: they take effect for this line and stay in effect for later lines until changed again. To sing a melody you wrote (for example the line you just gave compose_phrase or compose_render), put that same lead-sheet text in melody, with meter matching the compose section: each pitch needs one lyric syllable, "-" holds it and "." rests. To sing over a song you composed, pass the wav file compose_render returned as backing: it is mixed under the vocal and plays together with it from the same start. Set hear to true when you want this exact recording (with the backing) back as audio. Write Chinese lyrics as Han characters, Japanese as kana (needs a Japanese voicebank), English as space-separated words.

melody.description: Optional melody in the same lead-sheet text compose uses, e.g. "C4 D4 E4 - | G4 - - ."; "-" holds, "." rests, "|" separates bars. Omit to let the singer invent the melody.

meter.description: Meter of melody, e.g. 4/4 or 3/4; matched to the compose section. Default 4/4.

backing.description: Absolute path to a PCM16 wav to play under this line, e.g. the file compose_render returned (render the section without a melody for a clean backing). The vocal is mixed over it and they start together.

hear.description: Return this line's recording as an audio attachment so you can hear it (works when the model upstream accepts audio).

bpm.description: Tempo. 96 is the default; lower means slower ("唱慢一点" → 60–80).

keyShift.description: Transpose in semitones, positive is higher ("调高点" → +2..+4).

scale.description: Major is bright, minor is moody ("换小调" → minor).

summary.zh: 在本机把一句歌词唱出来；等它返回后再 pet_say 同一句歌词，气泡与声音同时出现。
summary.en: Sings one lyric line on this computer; call pet_say with the returned line afterwards, so the bubble appears together with the voice.

prompts.title: DiffSinger 唱歌 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
## 唱歌（DiffSinger · 绮萱（中））

状态：{{singer.state}}

- 桌宠或对话页里，用户让你唱、说「随便唱几句」「唱一个」「来一段」，或者气氛适合唱时，就真的唱：先调 `singer_sing`，`lyrics` 按刚才的聊天现写一句 8–16 字的中文歌词；**等它返回**，再看下面的「嘴型」决定用 `pet_say` 原样显示那句歌词，还是把歌词放进普通回复（不加引号、不加解释）。返回失败时不要拿歌词做气泡，如实说这次没唱成。
- 先唱后显示：`singer_sing` 要等这一句真正开始出声才返回，气泡才会跟声音一起出现。不要把 `singer_sing` 和 `pet_say` 放在同一批里一起发出去。
- 嘴型：{{singer.mouth}} 不要把嘴型动画说成音频对嘴；用户没问就不用解释。
- 用户说「唱慢一点 / 唱快一点 / 调高点 / 调低点 / 换小调」这类话时，不要让主人去设置页：下一次 `singer_sing` 直接带上 `bpm`（60–200，默认 96，慢一点≈66–80）、`keyShift`（半音，正数更高，高一点≈+2~+4）或 `scale`（major / minor）。这些值会沿用到再改一次为止。
- QQ 里点歌仍走 `qq_send`：`voice` 设为 true，正文只写「【唱】」加一句中文歌词；那条消息里不要写别的话。QQ 里不要调 `singer_sing`（它只在本机外放）。
- 想先说一句再说唱，桌宠 / 对话页就分两次回复：先 `pet_say` 说那句，下一轮再 `singer_sing` → 等返回 → `pet_say` 歌词。
- 唱日语要写假名（汉字没有读音会被跳过），而且得先把唱歌插件的声库换成日语声库；没换之前日语歌词唱不出来，会退回念。
- 唱英语按单词写（空格分词）；用自带英语词典的声库（绮萱自带，不用换）。要唱中文就换回中文声库。
- 状态是「未启动」时工具会先自动拉起引擎（随机启动关着、闲置回收后都算），不用让主人先去点启动；只有主人手动点过「停止服务」才会回没有声音，这时让他到「DiffSinger 唱歌」页点「启动服务」，别假装已经唱了。
- 想按**指定旋律**唱（和作曲世界配合）：把 compose_phrase / compose_render 里那条 `line` 原样放进 `singer_sing` 的 `melody`，`meter` 跟那一段的拍号一致，`bpm` 也照那一段的 tempo 填；歌词每个字对一个音，用 `-` 把长音延下去、`.` 留休止，字数要和音数对上。先 `compose_phrase` 听旋律，满意后再用同一条 line 让 `singer_sing` 唱，这是最稳的「写一段 → 补完 → 唱出来」流程。
- 作曲联动：{{singer.compose}}
- 想用自己的曲子当伴奏：先 `compose_render` 渲染一段**只有和弦与律动**（不写 `melody`）的段落，回执里有它的 `.wav` 路径；再按那一段的 `bpm` / `meter` 写歌唱旋律，调 `singer_sing` 时把路径填进 `backing`——歌声与伴奏会混成一条同时开始（伴奏开头 compose 留的约 0.3 秒静音会自动裁掉）。已有主旋律的曲子也能当伴奏，但主旋律会和歌声重复，最好用不写 melody 的版本。
- 想让自己听到刚才唱的那一句（上游模型支持音频时，例如 Gemini）：在同一次 `singer_sing` 里加 `hear: true`，回执会带上这句录音；不支持音频的模型只会看到一行说明。没有需要就别开，免得每句都多带一段音频。
